Home.seoTitle: Killer-Skills - AI Agent Skills Open Directory | Claude Code & Cursor Skills
Home.seoDescription: Discover 2,500+ AI agent skills and MCP servers for Claude Code, Cursor, and 19+ IDEs. Killer-Skills is the open Model Context Protocol directory and installation hub for AI coding assistants.
Home.faqSubtitle: Keeping the homepage snippet, visible content, and structured data aligned.
Home.faq1A: Killer-Skills is an open directory and installation entry point for reusable AI agent skills across Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and other compatible IDEs.
Home.faq2Q: Which IDEs can use these skills?
Home.faq2A: Most skills work with Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and 19+ other IDEs with a consistent installation flow.
Home.faq3Q: How do I install these skills?
Home.faq3A: You can open any skill page or use `npx killer-skills add owner/repo` to install a skill into any supported environment.
Home.faq4A: They are typically packaged as IDE-native skill files so you can install and reuse them directly in Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, and other compatible environments.
Home.faq5Q: Why start from the skill directory?
Home.faq5A: The detail page brings together the install command, supported IDEs, source repository, and related skills so you can quickly decide whether a skill fits your task.
